description_en: You can call the OnsMessageTrace operation to determine whether a message has been consumed based on its message ID
description_zh: 调用OnsMessageTrace根据Message ID来判断目标消息是否曾被消费过
name: OnsMessageTrace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message whose trace you want to query. This is the message ID
parameters.help_zh: 需查询消息轨迹的消息ID，即Message ID
parameters.name: msg_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the message belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

ConsumerGroup.description_en: The group ID of the consumer that subscribes to the topic
ConsumerGroup.description_zh: 订阅该Topic的消费者所对应的Group ID

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the message belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 需查询的消息所对应的实例ID

TrackType.description_en:
The current status. Valid values:

CONSUMED: The message was consumed.

CONSUMED_BUT_FILTERED: The message was filtered out and not consumed because it did not meet the subscription conditions of the group ID.

NOT_CONSUME_YET: The message has not been consumed.

NOT_ONLINE: The client is offline.

UNKNOWN: An unknown error occurred
TrackType.description_zh:
当前状态。取值说明如下：

CONSUMED：已消费。
CONSUMED_BUT_FILTERED：不符合Group ID的订阅条件，消息已被过滤，未消费。
NOT_CONSUME_YET：暂未消费。
NOT_ONLINE：客户端不在线。
UNKNOWN：其他问题

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
